title: Theory that Oppenheimer's security hearing was really about UFOs

tellings.quote: the head of the kangaroo court was a guy named Gordon gray who you know who

plain: Michels puts forward the idea that the security hearing against J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the atomic bomb work, was really about UFOs. He calls the hearing a kangaroo court run by a man named Gordon Gray, a name he connects to the Majestic 12 papers, documents describing a secret UFO group, and he also brings in the mathematician John von Neumann. If true, it would mean the bomb's builder was punished over UFO secrets.
